response.sql: SELECT scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor, AVG(scans.scancount) as avg_scancount, AVG(scans.pressratio) as avg_pressratio FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.scancount > 11 GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
